'''Welrin Maduk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who worked in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Maduk operated the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Fool's Paradise]]'', which he used to carry cargoes throughout the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]], and he sometimes carried out charter work for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Maduk landed the ''Fool's Paradise'' in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], loading the craft with a cargo of technical equipment that he planned to transport to a [[Forard research station|research station]] on the planet [[Almas]]. However, Maduk was attacked in his ship's landing bay by a group of [[Believers]] led by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] duo [[Kosa-Yin Hadu]] and [[Gar Granga]], who attempted to steal the ''Fool's Paradise''. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the Cularin system, came to Maduk's rescue and defeated the Believers. The agents then escorted Maduk and the ''Fool's Paradise'' to Almas.
